cues: Put the three side by side.
C3 plants fix carbon with RuBisCO and make 3-PGA first.
C4 and CAM both catch carbon dioxide with PEP carboxylase and make oxaloacetate first; C4 separates the steps in space, with Kranz anatomy, CAM in time, opening its stomata at night.
Both suppress photorespiration, but they do not abolish it.
